skill_name: Summarize the economy of China in 100 words.
workflow: The economy of China is one of the largest in the world and is made up of a mix of state-owned, private and foreign-invested companies. One of the world’s leading exporters of manufactured goods, it also has a large services sector and is one of the most important global sources of capital investment.
